|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 5) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[General Hux (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-General_Hux-2019-05-31-errata-slip.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-D-General_Hux-2019-05-31-errata-slip-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-D-General_Hux-original-2018-07-08-022435b.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V4-D-General_Hux-2019-05-31-errata-slip-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-D-General_Hux-2019-05-31-errata-slip.png]], 31 May 2019).
* '''Original''' ([[General Hux]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-generalhux022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/generalhux.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/generalhux.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Captain Yorr”. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 aboard Finalizer. Your First Order characters and [First Order] starships are destiny +1. Once per game, may take Strategic Reserves or a First Order stormtrooper into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC errata sheet slip (errata_2019-a.pdf, page 1), PDF dated 31 May 2019<ref name="slip-hux-2019a">Players Committee errata sheet [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_2019-a.pdf#page=1 errata_2019-a.pdf], page 1 (“Official text as of May 31, 2019”); the date is the PDF's creation date (31 May 2019).</ref> (the sheet says “Official text as of May 31, 2019”). '''What changed:''' “may take Strategic Reserves or a First” → “may take a First”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); a different printing: the errata sheet slip (printed for sleeving over the card) replaces the card image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “•Captain Yorr”. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 aboard Finalizer. Your First Order characters and [First Order] starships are destiny +1. Once per game, may take a First Order stormtrooper into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
